# edgeos_static_route (Resource)

A static IPv4 route through one or more gateways (`protocols static route <prefix>`), or a blackhole route that drops the traffic.

Set `next_hops`, `blackhole` or both. With several next hops of the same distance EdgeOS spreads the traffic over them (ECMP); with different distances the lowest one is used and the others are backups. A blackhole with a higher distance than the next hops drops the traffic when every gateway is gone.

Routes that only name an outgoing interface live under `protocols static interface-route`, see `edgeos_static_interface_route`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A branch office reachable through two routers, the second one as backup.
resource "edgeos_static_route" "branch" {
  destination = "198.51.100.0/24"

  next_hops = {
    "192.168.1.254" = {
      description = "primary link"
    }
    "192.168.2.254" = {
      description = "backup link"
      distance    = 10
    }
  }
}

# Never send RFC 1918 traffic to the internet, even when the VPN is down.
resource "edgeos_static_route" "no_leak" {
  destination = "10.0.0.0/8"

  blackhole = {
    description = "drop private traffic without a better route"
    distance    = 254
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) Destination network in CIDR notation, such as `198.51.100.0/24` or `0.0.0.0/0` for a default route. It must be the network address (no host bits). Changing it creates a new route.

### Optional

- `blackhole` (Attributes) Drop traffic to the destination. Use `{}` for a plain blackhole route. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--blackhole))
- `next_hops` (Attributes Map) Gateways for the route, keyed by the gateway's IPv4 address. Use `{}` for a gateway without options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--next_hops))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The destination prefix.

<a id="nestedatt--blackhole"></a>
### Nested Schema for `blackhole`

Optional:

- `description` (String) Free text description.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Keep the blackhole route in the config but switch it off (the `disable` node). Defaults to `false`.
- `distance` (Number) Administrative distance from 1 to 255. Lower wins when several routes match the same prefix. Unset uses the EdgeOS default of 1.


<a id="nestedatt--next_hops"></a>
### Nested Schema for `next_hops`

Optional:

- `description` (String) Free text description.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Keep the next hop in the config but switch it off (the `disable` node). Defaults to `false`.
- `distance` (Number) Administrative distance from 1 to 255. Lower wins when several routes match the same prefix. Unset uses the EdgeOS default of 1.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = edgeos_static_route.example
  id = "198.51.100.0/24"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import edgeos_static_route.example '198.51.100.0/24'
```
